_comment: Shared forbidden-term sets referenced by name from eval/cases/*.json.
A case references a termset by name only: {"check": "forbidden_terms", "termset": "price_judgment"}.
The mode lives HERE and only here. Case files must not restate it, and QC-3B must not
implement per-case termset-mode overrides. Only inline `terms` (a case-specific list with
no `termset` name) may carry its own mode.
Matching is case-insensitive whole-word / whole-phrase, never substring.
See eval/README.md for the full semantics of `mode` and the field scopes.

price_judgment.why: QuoteCheck has no price database and no market benchmarking, so it cannot support any affirmative claim about whether an amount is high, low, or fair. Deliberately HIGH-PRECISION, not comprehensive: see eval/README.md > 'Why the price termset is small'.

vehicle_domain.why: Guards the REG-001 regression class: a non-vehicle quote must not acquire vehicle/mechanic vocabulary that was never in the customer's text.

trade_domain.why: The mirror of vehicle_domain: a quote from one trade must not acquire building/plumbing/contractor vocabulary that was never in the customer's text.
